notes: The scenario establishes two directed interaction subscriptions, removes the first with the verified set overload, removes the remaining class subscription with the standard class-scoped overload, and queries through standard HLArequestSubscriptions. The final directed-subscription report is checked against the exact NULL response semantics in the IEEE 1516.2-2025 standard MIM. No DDM regions are used and no provider-independent conformance claim is made.

requirements.statement: The scenario invokes the IEEE 1516.1-2025 class-scoped Unsubscribe Object Class Directed Interactions overload for the class retaining a directed interaction subscription.

After no directed interactions remain subscribed, the standard MIM emits exactly one directed-subscription NULL response with HLAnumberOfClasses equal to zero, omits HLAobjectClass, and supplies an empty HLAinteractionClassList.
